surface_value: The prognosis for children with chronic granulomatous disease (CGD) has improved over the last three decades. The highest mortality is during early childhood, typically from infection. Without treatment, children usually die within the first decade of life. The mortality rate has fallen with modern preventative treatments of antibiotics, antifungals, and interferon therapy.
